verdict.rationale: The free-trial page names an 'Avalara Avi Agent' and describes conversational queries for analyzing accounts and exploring transactions. The AI use-cases page describes AI-assisted explanations of tax calculations and discrepancy detection with correction recommendations. This shows an AI assistant exists, but the evidence is thin on whether it is embedded in the AvaTax product UI and whether it can carry out delegated tasks rather than only answer and recommend. Missing for 10: dedicated Avi Agent documentation, evidence it is built into the AvaTax interface, evidence it can take actions on delegated tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
